source:
@@U03548@@
(They depart.)

@@U03550@@
Swiftly on a breeze they race Off to sunny Samothrace. What can they expect to gain Where the high 卡比里诸神 reign? Gods of wondrous kind are they, Ever self-begetting, Ever self-forgetting, Hover on your height, Fair Luna, in the night! Keep day away, And let us stay!

@@U03552@@
(On the shore, to 荷蒙库鲁斯.)

@@U03553@@
I'd gladly take you to old 涅柔斯, and, yes, we're not very far from his cave. He’s stubborn, though, you see, the rascally curmudgeon, hard as nails. There’s nothing the human race can do to please him. And yet, he does see into the future, and he’s greatly respected for that, I must say, and people come to do him honor. Besides, he’s been helpful to many a man.

@@U03555@@
Why don't we risk it? I dare say it won't cost me my glass and flame.

@@U03557@@
What’s that I hear? Human voices? What a rage it puts me in
translation:
@@U03548@@
（他们离开了。）

@@U03550@@
他们乘着微风迅速奔向阳光明媚的萨莫色雷斯。在卡比里诸神高位统治的地方，他们能指望得到什么？他们是奇妙善良的神，永远自生自灭，永远忘我，盘旋在你的高处，美丽的露娜，在夜晚！让日子远离，让我们留下来！

@@U03552@@
（在岸上，前往荷蒙库鲁斯。）

@@U03553@@
我很乐意带你去老涅柔斯，是的，我们离他的洞穴并不远。不过，你看，他很顽固，是个脾气暴躁、铁石心肠的人。人类无法做任何事来取悦他。然而，他确实看到了未来，我必须说，他因此受到了极大的尊重，人们来向他表示敬意。此外，他对很多人都有帮助。

@@U03555@@
我们为什么不冒险呢？我敢说这不会花费我的玻璃和火焰。

@@U03557@@
我听到什么？人类的声音？这让我多么愤怒
